observations.entity_name: Fall Creek Farm and Nursery, Inc.
observations.title: Moroccan protection for FC13-122
observations.summary: ONSSA's register as of June 22, 2026 lists FC13-122 under highbush blueberry and names Fall Creek Farm and Nursery, Inc. as holder. The listed protection expiry is April 15, 2051. Grant date, certificate number, licensees and local production scale are unrecorded in this list.

observations.title: Charter Horticulture's UC Davis strawberry master license
observations.summary: UC Davis lists Charter Horticulture as a South Africa master licensee for 19 named cultivars. The program defines this role as exclusive sublicensing rights for specified cultivars and territories for propagation and transfer of plants for fruit production. Agreement dates, sublicensees and actual nursery volumes are undisclosed.
observations.source_name: UC Davis Office of Research licensed nurseries and master licensees

observations.title: Miyoshi Agritech's YOTSUBOSHI seed production license

observations.title: GPG announces two Argentine nursery licenses for UC strawberry genetics
observations.summary: Global Plant Genetics announced nursery licenses for Kleppe S.A. and Vivero Altus. It identified San Andreas and Fronteras for propagation by both nurseries and described newer cultivars as a future focus. Effective dates, terms and plant volumes were undisclosed.
observations.source_name: Global Plant Genetics nursery licensing announcement

observations.title: Kleppe S.A. named for UC strawberry propagation in Argentina
observations.summary: Global Plant Genetics named Kleppe as a newly licensed strawberry nursery and identified San Andreas and Fronteras for propagation. Nursery throughput, realized plant sales and exact contract dates were undisclosed. Kleppe's broader fruit acreage is separate from strawberry nursery capacity.
observations.source_name: Global Plant Genetics nursery licensing announcement

observations.title: Vivero Altus named for UC strawberry propagation in Argentina
observations.summary: Global Plant Genetics named Vivero Altus, based in El Maitén, Patagonia, as a newly licensed strawberry nursery and identified San Andreas and Fronteras for propagation. Nursery throughput, realized plant sales and exact contract dates were undisclosed.
observations.source_name: Global Plant Genetics nursery licensing announcement

observations.title: Bayer's announced Baya Solara availability for Northern European protected cropping
observations.summary: Bayer announced Baya Solara (EM2836) as De Ruiter's first commercial strawberry variety on January 8, 2026, naming the United Kingdom, Germany and Benelux as intended availability markets. Grower adoption, hectares, volumes and cultivar-rights status are outside the release's disclosed scope.

observations.title: EU plant variety right granted for Dalicia strawberry
observations.summary: CPVO's August 15, 2025 journal records EU plant variety right 69689 for the legal denomination Dalicia under application 2022/1955. The grant decision date is June 2, 2025, and the journal's holder code 03292 identifies Angus Soft Fruits Ltd. Subsequent status, expiry and commercial scale were not established by this grant record.

observations.entity_name: Jiangsu Youwei Organic Food Co., Ltd. (江苏悠维有机食品有限公司)
observations.title: Jiangsu Youwei's blackberry growing base in Nanjing
observations.summary: A June 2025 report published by Nanjing's Agriculture and Rural Affairs Bureau describes an organic blackberry site that Jiangsu Youwei established in 2017 in Aimin Village, Dongping, Lishui District. The report puts planted blackberry area at that site above 1,000 mu. Site yield and shipment volumes are undisclosed.
observations.source_name: Nanjing Agriculture and Rural Affairs Bureau site report

metric.scope: Planted blackberry area at the Aimin Village site
metric.qualifier: Strict lower bound reported in June 2025

milestones.title: UC Davis lists Charter Horticulture as a South Africa master licensee
milestones.summary: UC Davis lists 19 strawberry cultivars in Charter's South African scope: Monterey, Portola, San Andreas, Benicia, Petaluma, Fronteras, Cabrillo, UCD Moxie, UCD Royal Royce, UCD Valiant, UCD Victor, UCD Warrior, UCD Finn, UCD Mojo, UC Eclipse, UC Surfline, UC Monarch, UC Keystone and UC Golden Gate. The master role covers exclusive sublicensing for propagation and transfer of plants for fruit production within the listed territory and cultivars. Sublicensees, effective dates and nursery throughput are undisclosed.

sources.source_name: UC Davis Office of Research licensed nurseries and master licensees

milestones.title: YOTSUBOSHI Japanese seed supply through three licensed producers
milestones.summary: The March 2025 MAFF handbook names Miyoshi Agritech, Bio-Yu and Mie Kono Anotsu Enken as licensed domestic seed producers. Mie, Chiba, Kagawa and NARO hold the Japanese rights. The report names Sakata Seed and Miyoshi as overseas registration partners, reports applications in 12 countries or regions, and describes a Japan-only seed production model. NARO records domestic sales starting in fiscal 2016 and aggregate fiscal 2019 sales of 1.10 million plug seedlings and 970,000 seeds, equivalent to about 30 hectares. Current volumes, contract dates and each foreign grant status are unrecorded here.

sources.source_name: Japan MAFF IP management handbook, pp. 111–112
NARO YOTSUBOSHI seed supply follow-up

milestones.title: Italy recognizes an EasyRose raspberry accession as eligible for QVI certification
milestones.summary: Italy's November 28, 2025 decree took effect upon gazette publication on December 18, 2025. The signed annex lists Rubus idaeus, the denomination ALEL101PVR, the EasyRose brand, clone ALCAV and accession RID0010. The measure recognizes eligibility for Italy's voluntary propagation material certification scheme. The annex lists CPVO authorization code 20250014 and leaves Italian or EU plant-rights grant number and date blank. Certified plant volumes are unrecorded.

sources.source_name: Italian Official Gazette decree 25A06708
Italian Ministry of Agriculture signed decree annex, p. 4

milestones.title: GPG names Kleppe and Vivero Altus as Argentine strawberry nursery licensees
milestones.summary: Global Plant Genetics announced that it licensed Kleppe S.A. and Vivero Altus in Argentina to propagate UC strawberry cultivars including San Andreas and Fronteras. It identified UCD Royal Royce, UC Eclipse and UC Golden Gate as forward priorities. The two announced nursery licenses establish scope at the announcement date. Exact contract dates, terms, planted volume and sales were undisclosed.

sources.source_name: Global Plant Genetics nursery licensing announcement

milestones.title: Bayer announces Baya Solara (EM2836) for protected strawberry cropping
milestones.summary: Bayer announced De Ruiter's first commercial strawberry cultivar on January 8, 2026. The company described Baya Solara (EM2836) as an early to mid-season June-bearer for protected cropping and named the United Kingdom, Germany and Benelux as its availability scope. The announcement gives no measured commercial adoption, acreage, production volume or cultivar-rights status.

milestones.title: Fall Creek reports acquisition of Italy's Berryplant and Berrytech
milestones.summary: Fall Creek's release dated June 10, 2026 says it acquired Berryplant, a Trentino raspberry and blackberry nursery, and Berrytech, its breeding and IP sister company. Berryplant will continue as Fall Creek Italia, with both businesses operating separately during the initial transition. Fall Creek's press index lists the same release under June 4, so the first posting date is unclear. Transaction counsel reported the acquisition on June 11. The precise legal closing date and financial terms are undisclosed.

sources.source_name: Fall Creek acquisition release
Fall Creek press index (displays June 4 for the same release)
Osborne Clarke transaction counsel statement

milestones.summary: Fall Creek announced on October 1, 2026 that it entered an exclusive propagation and sales license with Lucchini Berries SRL for the primocane raspberry Easy Rose (ALEL101), developed by Elisa and Alessandro Lucchini in Verona. The company describes evaluation or planting in Italy, Spain, Portugal, Mexico, Morocco and Egypt. The agreement's territory, exact signing date, term and volumes are undisclosed.

milestones.title: CNIPA recognizes Baima blackberry as a geographical indication product
milestones.summary: China's National Intellectual Property Administration recognized Baima blackberry (白马黑莓) under Announcement 640, dated July 16, 2025 and published August 13. Annex 1 lists the Lishui District Blackberry Association as applicant and defines the origin as specified localities in and around Baima Town. The decision protects a geographical product designation. Cultivar ownership and plant variety rights are separate legal questions.
places: Baima Town and specified nearby localities, Lishui District, Nanjing, China
